Campolide — Lisbon, Portugal

🟡 Local press research

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Campolide has been repeatedly named in a documented wave of armed robberies: a "Rolex gang" has held victims up at gunpoint since 2025, continuing into January 2026, targeting people around Avenida da Liberdade, Amoreiras and Campolide; a shopkeeper was stabbed multiple times during an armed robbery of an electronics store in December 2025. In Lisbon's parish security survey, Campolide's own junta named simple theft, vehicle break-ins and drug-product trafficking as the most common problems locally, saying they create a "generalised sense of insecurity." Older reporting also documents long-standing neglect and marginality issues around the Bela Flor social-housing pocket. Sources checked: SOL/IOL, 23 Jan 2026 – "Roubos de luxo em Lisboa fazem soar alarmes" (gang dos Rolex, Campolide named among target areas); Now (nowcanal.pt) – "Onda de assaltos luxuosos em Lisboa: gang dos Rolex volta a atacar em Campolide"; CNN Portugal / TVI, 12 Dec 2025 – "Lojista esfaqueado após roubo a loja de informática em Campolide"; Observador, special report (2024/2025 series) – "Insegurança em Lisboa ou mera perceção?" (Campolide junta on theft/drug trafficking and "insegurança generalizada"); PCP Lisboa, 28 May 2008 – "Campolide: Bela Flor um bairro ao abandono".
